raw: {"analysis":"Response VWR correctly identifies that the legacy module is written in an older internal dialect and proposes appropriate tooling (Hypothesis/QuickCheck) while handling the mock-ledger 4h TTL with a pre-check hook. Response RCS incorrectly suggests building the test scaffolding 'using the internal dialect' which contradicts the property-based testing requirement, and its parallelization logic is muddled (Lane B runs in parallel with Lane A once schema is known, but also depends on Lane A's invariants). Response VWR also provides more concrete CI optimization details (running only property tests on PRs, $50 budget cap) and properly sequences the behavioral archaeology work before test construction, while Response RCS's approach to having Lane B start before invariants are defined creates unnecessary rework risk.","verdict":"VWR"}
